args.decision_needed: The tenant reports the landlord's LG washing machine (there when they moved in) has a power failure and says it cannot be fixed (their own web search, not diagnosed). They offer to buy a replacement that would remain their property, not on the inventory, and be taken with them when they leave. Please tell us: (1) do you consent to the tenant fitting their own machine; (2) who pays to disconnect and remove the existing machine and fit the new one; (3) what should happen to your machine (inspect, repair or dispose); (4) may the tenant's machine stay connected. Alternatively we can send our contractor to inspect and repair or replace yours.
options: Consent to the tenant's own machine, with you or tenant paying removal/fitting (please say which) and a decision on your machine
Our contractor inspects your machine first, to confirm whether it is repairable
